claim: Only unpaid rent, damage or bills may be deducted from the deposit
quote: השוכר לא פינה את הדירה המושכרת בתום תקופת השכירות ... המשכיר יודיע לשוכר זמן סביר מראש על כוונתו לממש את הערובה
actual: Four cases: unpaid rent (plus linkage and interest), defects the tenant must fix (up to repair cost), current payments (arnona, utilities, building committee), and failure to vacate. The landlord must give the tenant reasonable advance notice and time to fix.
fix: List all four cases and add the notice duty, or say 'the law lists specific cases'.

claim: Landlord gives notice 90 days before the end, tenant 60 days (s.25יב)
quote: לא יאוחר מ־90 ימים לפני תום תקופת השכירות, אם ברצונו לקיים את הברירה
actual: The 90 and 60 days apply only where a party has an option to extend, and each is the notice of exercising that party's own option. Otherwise the landlord must say 'a reasonable time before the end' whether he wants to extend. (A separate 90/60 rule applies to a no-cause cancellation clause, s.25יג(ב).) The lease clause 'landlord gives 90 days if he does not intend to extend, as the law requires' is not what s.25יב says.
fix: Rewrite: 'If a party has an option to extend: landlord 90 days, tenant 60 days before the end (s.25יב)'; fix the lease clause.

claim: Tip 3a: pulling a credit report on someone else is forbidden (Credit Data Law)
source: Credit Data Law s.26(א), s.27, s.32(א), s.25, s.110 https://he.wikisource.org/wiki/חוק_נתוני_אשראי
quote: מי שאינו נותן אשראי יהיה רשאי לקבל מלשכת אשראי דוח אשראי, בתנאים שיקבע השר
actual: No sentence bans a landlord outright. The law lets a credit bureau pass a credit report only to a credit provider, for a credit deal with that customer, with the customer's explicit consent (s.26(א)(1),(4)); a non-credit-provider may receive one only if the Minister so decides (s.32). Use for a different purpose is an offence (s.89(ב)(1)). Section 110 bans demanding credit data for employment (and from 26.1.2027 also for entering a deal for services or products).
fix: Say what the sections say (see replacement below), without 'forbidden on someone else'.

claim: Tip 2: everyone gets a free credit data report from the Bank of Israel once a year
source: Credit Data Law s.38(ד) https://he.wikisource.org/wiki/חוק_נתוני_אשראי ; boi.org.il (credit data page)
quote: דוח ריכוז נתונים יימסר ללקוח בלא תשלום, לפי בקשתו, אחת לשנה
actual: Right is for a 'customer' (an adult individual), the report is called a data summary report (דוח ריכוז נתונים), extra reports in the same year are paid. BOI site: 'ניתן להפיק בחינם אחת לשנה'.
fix: Use the statute's term and 'an adult individual'.

claim: Tip 2b: the person 'can share it by choice'
quote: נותן אשראי לא יבקש מלקוח דוח ריכוז נתונים לגביו או דוח אשראי שנמסר ללקוח מנותן אשראי אחר לפי חוק זה
actual: The law is silent on a customer sharing his report with a landlord. The only related rule bans a credit provider (from 26.1.2027) from asking customers for such a report.
fix: Delete the sentence.
